newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors questioning vice president Fujita -DKB.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors questioning vice president Fujita -DKB.

text.p: Tokyo prosecutors are questioning Ichiro Fujita, the current executive vice-president of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB), the bank said on Friday.

Asked about media reports that Fujita was being questioned on suspicion of possible links to a racketeer payoff scandal involving the top Japanese commercial bank, a bank spokeswoman said: "The reports about the questioning appear to be true."

On Tuesday, four former DKB executives were arrested on suspicion of violating the Commercial Code with payoffs in the form of illicit loans to a "sokaiya" racketeer. The arrest came shortly after the bank unveiled a top management shake-up, its second in less than a month.

The latest arrests followed the arrests last week of four other DKB officials on suspicion of extending uncollateralised loans to Ryuichi Koike, the racketeer at the centre of a scandal which has also embroiled Nomura Securities Co.
